WelcomeSection.heading: Welcome to Little Flower Group of Schools
WelcomeSection.description: For over four decades, Little Flower has been dedicated to providing quality, value-based education across Eastern Uttar Pradesh. We believe that true education nurtures the mind, body, and spirit.
WelcomeSection.quote: Education is not merely the transmission of knowledge; it is the ignition of character, curiosity, and compassion.

NoteOfSupportSection.anandKumarQuote: LFCS's mission of bringing quality, affordable education to every community aligns deeply with the philosophy of Super 30. I am honored to support their School Associate initiative.
NoteOfSupportSection.sharmanJoshiQuote: Education for all is the foundation of a progressive nation. Little Flower Schools' commitment to holistic child development is truly inspiring.
